# Isaiah Chapter 58 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 14 verses]*

*True vs. false fasting; loose bonds; share bread; light breaks forth; Sabbath delight*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

*-- LOGOS*
